description: This file defines configuration options and functions for setting up the server and application components in the Mattermost server, including store overrides, configuration, clustering, and logging.

methods.name: StoreOverride
methods.description: Returns an Option to override the store with a custom implementation or function.

methods.name: StoreOverrideWithCache
methods.description: Returns an Option to override the store with a cached store implementation.

methods.name: StoreOption
methods.description: Returns an Option to set a specific SQL store option.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns an Option to set the server configuration via DSN or config defaults.

methods.name: ConfigStore
methods.description: Returns an Option to set a custom configuration store, typically for testing.

methods.name: SetFileStore
methods.description: Returns an Option to set the file backend store.

methods.name: ForceEnableRedis
methods.description: Returns an Option to force enable Redis.

methods.name: WithLicense
methods.description: Sets a license for the platform service.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger for platform service, requires platform to be initialized.

methods.name: ServerConnector
methods.description: Creates an AppOption to connect a Channels instance to the App.

methods.name: SetCluster
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the cluster implementation.
